content.short: Coin98 is a multi-chain super wallet for managing crypto assets, DApps, swaps, bridges, and Web3 access.
content.description: Coin98 is a non-custodial, multi-chain crypto wallet and Web3 gateway. Its ecosystem includes a mobile wallet, AI wallet, Telegram wallet, DApp browser, built-in DEX access, cross-chain bridge tools, decentralized identity features, and card products. Coin98 highlights support for more than 140 blockchains and thousands of compatible DApps, giving users one place to store assets, connect to applications, swap tokens, and manage approvals. For Mantle users, Coin98 provides a consumer wallet interface for accessing the broader Mantle ecosystem alongside many other networks.
content.meta: Coin98 is a multi-chain Web3 wallet for crypto assets, DApps, swaps, bridges, and identity. Discover Coin98 on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
